cd /workspace && cat > tmp/maxcost.py <<'EOF'
import ipaddress, json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fib, main as M, gen
from protocol import parse_request
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1)
# two versions with 64 runs each (total 128), maximum bursts/addresses/costs
def rows_target(target):
    routes={(0,0):0}; rows=[["::/0",0]]; hop=1; guard=0
    while len(fib.runs_of(routes)[0])<target and guard<3000:
        guard+=1
        length=rng.choice([128,128,120,96,64])
        v=rng.getrandbits(128); size=1<<(128-length); v=(v//size)*size
        if (v,length) in routes: continue
        trial=dict(routes); trial[(v,length)]=hop
        if len(fib.runs_of(trial)[0])<=target:
            routes=trial; rows.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))+"/%d"%length,hop]); hop+=1
    return rows
rows=rows_target(64)
bursts=[]
for v in (0,1):
    for _ in range(128):
        bursts.append({"version":v,"repeat":1000000,
                       "addresses":[str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(rng.getrandbits(128))) for _ in range(32)]})
case={"initial":rows,"transactions":[[[ "set","::/0",5]]],"bursts":bursts,"cache_pages":12,
      "costs":{"hit":16,"miss":256,"decode":[16,16,16]}}
payload=json.dumps({"cases":[case]}).encode()
norm=parse_request(payload)
tot=sum(len(s) for c in norm for s,_ in fib.publish(c["initial"],c["transactions"]))
print("total runs",tot,"bursts",len(bursts))
t=time.time(); out1=M.compile_request(norm,True); t1=time.time()-t
t=time.time(); out2=M.compile_request(norm,False); t2=time.time()-t
print("native %.2fs python %.2fs"%(t1,t2))
print("native:",out1["cases"][0]["objective"])
print("python:",out2["cases"][0]["objective"])
assert out1["cases"][0]["objective"]==out2["cases"][0]["objective"], "PLANNER MISMATCH"
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); import light
light.check(json.loads(payload),out1,samples=20)
print("OK")
EOF
